en: A vintage black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) postcard showing a small Romanesque-style church with a tall narrow bell tower and a rose window above the main entrance. The church stands at the end of a short path bordered by low walls, with trees and hills in the background and a small adjacent house to the right. Printed captions identify the city and the church; there is also a handwritten signature in ink on the right side.
